$comment: The curation behind this repository's open `rule-proposal` issues for SonarQube parity.
LICENCE BOUNDARY (docs/plan/17 s. The licence): sonar-dotnet is under the SONAR
Source-Available License v1.0. This file records rule ids and this repository's own
judgement about them. It carries none of SonarSource's rule prose, and the audit was done
against analyzers/rspec/cs metadata only -- analyzers/src/** was never fetched or read.
Every published C# rule appears exactly once, in `concepts[].rules` or in `resolved`.

curatedAgainst.method: Testing/parity-analysis/fetch_sonar.py fetches the same metadata by API
